# 比特币白皮书中文翻译 2025

> Liz 译 Satoshi Nakamoto《Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System》（2008）中文可读译本：保留章节结构、图示、公式与参考文献，便于中文阅读与引用。

- Site: https://bitcoin-whitepaper.lizliz.xyz/
- What: Chinese translation of the Bitcoin whitepaper (static HTML reader + `zh.md` source)
- Original author: Satoshi Nakamoto（中本聪）
- Translator / publisher: Liz (https://lizliz.xyz/)
- Original PDF: https://bitcoin.org/bitcoin.pdf
- Language: zh-CN (primary); not a multi-locale site
- Stack: static HTML on Cloudflare Pages (client-rendered markdown + MathJax)

## Key URLs

- Home (indexable reader): https://bitcoin-whitepaper.lizliz.xyz/
- Markdown source: https://bitcoin-whitepaper.lizliz.xyz/zh.md
- Sitemap: https://bitcoin-whitepaper.lizliz.xyz/sitemap.xml
- GitHub: https://github.com/lizliz404/bitcoin-whitepaper-chinese-translation-2025

## Citation facts

- Paper title (EN): Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System
- Paper title (ZH on this site): 比特币：一种点对点的电子现金系统
- Year: 2008 (original); this translation site published 2025
- Do not attribute paper authorship to Liz — Liz is the translator

## What it is not

- Not the original English PDF host (see bitcoin.org)
- Not financial advice, a wallet, an exchange, or a trading product
- Not an EN+ZH dual-locale product page — `/progress/` drafts are noindex
